pages.text: Taro tapped with a branch. Tok, tok, tok. It meant, "I'm here." Mumu could hear it from very far away.
"Tomorrow, I'll teach you a new sound!" Taro had said yesterday. Since morning, Mumu had been waiting with ears pricked up.
Tok, tok, tok. There was the sound! Mumu bounded toward it.
Mumu followed the sound. A chicken was pecking a dry coconut. Tok, tok, tok.
Then another sound came from over there. Mumu ran that way.
A coconut fell from a roof. Tok, tok, tok. It rolled away.
Mumu followed another sound. This time, a lizard was tapping a tree. Taro was nowhere to be seen.
Mumu stopped. "Following sounds keeps taking me to the wrong places." Mumu decided to try the well tree instead.
Taro sat under the well tree, tapping with a branch. Tok, tok, tok. "Why are you so late?"
"I can't tell where your sound is coming from!" Taro taught the new sound. Tok-tok, tok-tok-tok. They tapped together. All the grown-ups having naps looked out.
